params.baseInstructions: Complete the supplied mathematical task using only its explicit inputs and tools. Submit the requested JSON artifact through submit_artifact. Tool feedback is real task feedback; do not invent a successful check. This is a Yui workflow stage. Read the relevant declared Yui rules, preserve the supplied proof route and exact allowed assumptions, and distinguish mathematical review from structural checks.

dynamicTools.name: search_mathlib
dynamicTools.description: 在固定 mathlib 的 Lean 源码中搜索正则表达式，返回至多 100 行。

dynamicTools.name: read_mathlib
dynamicTools.description: 读取固定 mathlib 中一个 Mathlib/...lean 文件的指定行。

dynamicTools.name: read_task_input
dynamicTools.description: Read an explicitly frozen task document by ID; no other local files are accessible.

dynamicTools.name: read_yui
dynamicTools.description: Read declared Yui rules/templates; no tests, historical runs or personal files.

dynamicTools.name: check_artifact
dynamicTools.description: Check a JSON artifact against the explicit stage contract; this is not automatic mathematical certification.

dynamicTools.name: submit_artifact
dynamicTools.description: Submit a JSON artifact after its stage checks.

dynamicTools.name: report_obstacle
dynamicTools.description: Stop this stage honestly on a substantive or suspected proof gap, unavailable source, or input conflict. JSON fields: status, location, explanation, basis, partial_progress. Status must be SUBSTANTIVE_GAP, SUSPECTED_GAP, SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE or INPUT_CONFLICT. Difficulty alone is not a mathematical error.

dynamicTools.name: probe_library
dynamicTools.description: Query a proved Mathlib theorem and its exact signature/axioms in the offline sandbox. Returns located evidence for an M source; the mathematical statement and applicability still require review.

input.text:
Complete the existing wave-map NL0 v2 candidate by local format/source repairs. The prior obstacle explicitly says that this is a source/graph completion failure, not a mathematical gap; continue that ordinary work. Preserve the supplied compact-box, uniform difference-quotient, compact-support integration-by-parts and tangency route. Complete the FTC/Fubini and other actual source records or derivations, and existence-before-witness inventories. Keep integrability, Frobenius energy and every interior-time derivative in the exact user-approved target. Read every frozen input and Yui NL0 rules, especially templates/submission-example.md for the complete spec/graph data shape and existence-before-witness bookkeeping. Preserve the exact original target and H; the controller changes only inputs,pins,graph.spec_sha256, not mathematical statements. Every H graph statement must copy its own submitted spec.hypotheses statement exactly. Register substantive imported facts as actual M/E sources or prove them locally; no analytical theorem may hide in calculation primitives. Use live Mathlib search/read and probe_library (dotted module names such as Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.Prod). Complete the normal derivations and local source/application records along the supplied route. Rejected schema candidates are format feedback, not a mathematical gap or missing H contract; no fixed submission-attempt limit applies while actual stage time remains. An obstacle report saying a standard source/derivation is merely not yet completed does not establish a substantive gap in the original work. Submit exactly {spec,graph}; structural acceptance is not Audit A, which will follow separately. 

Submission has exactly {"spec": <NL0 v2 specification>, "graph": <NL0 v2 graph>}. The controller binds spec.inputs to all frozen task documents, pins to the verified runtime, and graph.spec_sha256 to the resulting spec. Supply these fields as placeholders if needed. All mathematical fields remain your responsibility. probe_library returns checked M-source evidence inside this stage case directory; source.statement and hypotheses still need complete mathematical text. A successful check_artifact is structural validation, not Audit A acceptance.
Frozen structural contract: spec.format_version=2; graph.format_version=2; spec.case_id=graph.case_id="wave-map-energy". The controller-bound pins are {"lean_version": "4.32.2", "mathlib_commit": "905b95818eb32af7874a58b427f50c1711a5e96c", "mathlib_root": "/Users/syyui/formalization-tools/lean-mathlib-v4.32.2/mathlib"}. These are provided configuration facts, not guessed mathematical premises. Spec.inputs, spec.pins and graph.spec_sha256 are rebound deterministically, so their placeholder values are not an input conflict. All other required schema fields must be supplied normally.
Exact permitted machine rule names for spec.logic.rules and inference.rules: ["case_elimination", "contradiction_classical", "direct", "exists_elimination", "forall_introduction", "implication_introduction", "modus_ponens", "natural_induction", "negation_introduction"]. Use these identifiers; put mathematical derivations in argument text, not invented rule enum values. Parameters are a list of {symbol,type}; logic is an object {classical,rules,calculations,primitives}. Inferences use R001-style IDs; argument paragraphs use S001-style IDs; propositions use H001/E001/M001/N001 or P. An unknown field/rule is a format repair, not a mathematical gap. Read references/nl0-format.md for every remaining field.
Yui entry: read_yui(path="SKILL.md", start=1, end=200).
